title: How Reading Scripture Out Loud Slows a Distracted Man Down
caption:
Your eyes can skim a chapter in ninety seconds and keep none of it. Your voice can't.

Reading the Bible out loud forces you to take every word at the speed of a person talking, and a distracted man finally has to stay in the room.

Save this and try it tomorrow, before the phone.
